mx.teacher_note: This food contains at least two different nutrients.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: All foods contain both proteins and fats.

intelligence.enrichment: A food item may show the presence of more than one nutrient; peanuts show the presence of both proteins and fats. multiple positive food-test results for one food item -> evidence that the item contains multiple nutrients The learner correctly applies this rule: A food item may show the presence of more than one nutrient; peanuts show the presence of both proteins and fats. Each food item belongs to exactly one nutrient group, so one positive test cancels the others.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body. The student must decide: Explain from food-test results that one food item can contain more than one nutrient, such as peanuts showing both proteins and fats. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Retarget the source onto this Science decision. Keep the source item type. Recalculate the key.
